all.description: complete advanced and deprecated option inventory

exit_codes.2: invalid usage, input, profile, or output path
exit_codes.70: internal or tooling error prevented command startup

direct_launchers: repo-local ./scripts/lidarslam after a matching workspace build
environment_activation_contract.behavior: activate the nearest aggregate setup.bash tied to the selected installed product or source checkout before delegating
matching_rules: derive an installed prefix from the selected curated lidarslam_cli.py resource
for a source checkout require the candidate install tree to contain and delegate to the curated installed lidarslam_cli.py resource
never search arbitrary filesystem locations or source an unrelated parent workspace
environment_activation_contract.shell_rule: activation affects only the launcher process and its children; it does not modify the caller's shell
environment_activation_contract.normal_path_rule: the short lidarslam-map name still follows normal PATH activation or package-manager installation

interactive_home_contract.trigger: no command on a terminal with interactive stdin and stdout
interactive_home_contract.non_interactive_behavior: preserve stderr help and usage exit code 2
safety_rules: route only to existing beginner workflows and never add a second implementation
show the exact copy-ready delegated command before execution
require an explicit yes before the demo can download or write
retain the start command sensor and calibration review before mapping
run the doctor route without confirmation because it uses no network and writes no files
cancel, EOF, or unrecognized confirmation starts no delegated command

system_doctor_contract.system_mode: omit rosbag2_dir to check product files, installed-prefix activation, supported ROS, rosbag2_py, and fixed-demo storage
system_doctor_contract.bag_mode: provide rosbag2_dir to retain the existing topic, field, timestamp, and maintained-profile preflight
safety_rules: system mode uses no network and writes no files
JSON omits checkout, install-prefix, home, and demo-directory paths
storage reports exact additional bytes required and a placeholder-free retry command
bag mode delegates to the existing preflight implementation
--public-json requires a bag and emits only type/count/check/profile/finding-code evidence without bag paths, topic or frame names, local commands, raw data, raw logs, or free-text messages
--public-json emits the same path-free schema with bag-preflight-input-error when the local input cannot be read
every human bag report warns that the full report remains local and displays one shell-safe --public-json command for the exact input
a ready human bag report reached through the product CLI displays one shell-safe exact-input start command and hides lower-level mapping alternatives
a human bag report with findings reached through the product CLI withholds start and displays the exact-input doctor retry after the first finding

the product human bag card is bounded to status, bag duration and count, input types without topic or frame names, selected profile, check statuses, the first finding and remaining finding codes, and one next action
the product human bag card displays one shell-safe exact-input --json command for complete private local detail while direct preflight use retains the expert human report
system-only storage options fail closed when a bag is provided
extend the existing retained-run inspector instead of adding another doctor or tuning surface
return ordered checks and shell-safe product commands without editing parameters or launching mapping
check sensor, timestamp, calibration, and TF contracts before registration or loop-closure tuning
never convert a reported visual symptom into a root-cause, vendor-support, or accuracy claim
never overwrite the retained session and never upload a support bundle

dataset_rules: use the fixed checksum-pinned Driving SLAM Test with Livox MID360 dataset
retain Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14841855 and CC-BY-4.0 attribution
delegate mapping to run_first_map_demo.sh and the maintained rko_lio_graph_mid360_preset lifecycle
safety_rules: dry-run writes nothing and performs no network request
reject cache/output overlap, exact symlink targets, and unverified existing output
check the configured free-space floor before any download or map process
low-storage findings report exact additional bytes and preserve a copy-ready retry command
treat cache presence as unverified and re-hash the registered archive and extracted bag files before mapping
offer --resume only for schema-valid terminal post-processing stages and never restart mapping through resume
reuse an existing output only after rebuilding and matching its schema-valid receipt-bound PASS evidence
a zero delegated exit without complete verified evidence is failure
first_map_demo_plan_contract.viewer_rule: viewer failure never replaces a verified map result

sensor_setup_rejection_contract.operator_rule: key on stable codes; display messages and next actions

safety_rules: live interactive start renders one calibration review then asks one fail-closed confirmation without presenting a second --yes command
non-interactive start, setup, and dry-run retain the exact reviewed rerun command
decline, EOF, or unreviewed calibration starts no mapping

display_rules: confirmed live start skips the repeated setup review and proceeds directly to its map start and progress card
setup and dry-run retain the complete selected input, calibration, and map command review
the compact live handoff does not alter sensor_setup.json, session index, progress, or recovery contracts

map_session_recovery_contract.browser_behavior: render action_required in the common session page; open for start --viewer browser and retain without opening for --viewer none
browser_rules: self-contained HTML with no network resources
escape bag paths, diagnosis text, evidence paths, and commands
an HTML write failure must not suppress session.json or the JSON recovery contract
opening failure must not replace the delegated map exit code
safety_rules: preserve setup and run evidence
resume terminal post-processing only when manifest-v2 proves it is safe
retry the pinned setup only into a fresh output directory

one Ctrl-C makes the stable CLI wait for the start helper, signals the complete isolated delegated process group, waits up to 20 seconds for cleanup and terminal evidence before requesting termination, waits 10 more seconds before a forced group reap, and then renders the same one-action recovery handoff without a Python traceback, false timeout label, or recent-launch-log dump
terminal_rules: render the first reason, any remaining stable finding codes, exactly one next_command, and one retained detail path
do not repeat per-finding actions, retry alternatives, or inspect alternatives in the default terminal card
retain every finding, action, retry, inspect command, and evidence path in map_session_recovery.json and the derived session handoff
map_session_recovery_contract.operator_rule: run next_command first; key automation on reason.code

status_rules: running has no runner exit code, reports the durable lifecycle stage, and refreshes session.html automatically
verified requires --verification required and result PASS
unverified requires --verification off and is never worded as verified
action_required retains the detailed map_session_recovery.json source
progress_rules: durable lifecycle stage changes update session.json and session.html and print the new stage
an unchanged live stage prints at most one terminal heartbeat every 30 seconds with its label and monotonic elapsed time but performs no session artifact write
heartbeats report neither percentage nor ETA and do not claim that the delegated workflow made forward progress
map_session_index_contract.action_rule: for terminal statuses, actions[0] is the recommended copy-ready next action
quality_rules: summarize workflow, map output, Autoware verification, and evidence integrity without inventing a numeric score
bind terminal PASS to a schema-valid first_map_validation_receipt.json containing all seven required check ids
render verification-off as not_verified rather than fail
render missing, malformed, or semantically incomplete quality receipts as unavailable
retain source check ids in each derived quality card
viewer_rules: start opens the running session.html before launching the map runner when a desktop browser is available
running session.html refreshes every 2 seconds and is atomically regenerated only when the durable lifecycle stage changes
after map completion, browser preview generation uses view --viewer browser --no-open and the same session.html links the result
viewer failure remains separate from map status
session artifact generation and browser opening never overwrite source or map evidence
terminal_rules: a successful start renders one VERIFIED or UNVERIFIED completion card instead of separate completion and summary blocks
the completion card contains map output, verification, viewer, session index, session page, evidence paths, and exactly one recommended Next command
viewer failure makes the single Next action the view retry, adds one warning, and does not change verified map status
session-index generation failure retains a completed fallback card with the map output and one view command

scan_rules: never follow bundle, session.json, session.html, or output report symlinks
accept only schema-valid map-session-index-v1 session.json files no larger than 2 MiB
sort valid sessions newest first and cap displayed entries at 200
report invalid candidates as a count without exposing their contents
map_session_catalog_contract.json_rule: --json is read-only and neither writes nor opens sessions.html
browser_rules: self-contained HTML with no network resources
escape profile labels, paths, summaries, quality text, and commands
link only to a regular non-symlink session.html inside each scanned bundle
catalog write or browser-open failure never changes valid session evidence

evidence_rules: compare readiness only from schema-valid session.json evidence
compare setup only from a schema-valid sensor_setup.json whose session, bag, output, profile, and current parameter snapshots still match
represent missing, stale, malformed, or identity-mismatched evidence as unavailable instead of inferring a value
compare recorded artifact names without treating current files as retained proof
decision_rules: do not calculate a numeric score
do not select or imply a winner
report every row as same, different, or unavailable
map_session_comparison_contract.json_rule: --json is read-only and neither writes nor opens comparison HTML
browser_rules: self-contained HTML with no network resources
escape session names, profile labels, paths, and recorded values
link only to regular non-symlink session.html files inside the compared bundles
refuse to replace symlinks or files not generated by this comparison command
browser-open failure never changes a successful comparison result

privacy_rules: exclude map geometry, raw sensor data, raw logs, and parameter-file contents
redact exact local paths and credential-like command values
project only bounded status, identity hashes, sensor setup, calibration, and artifact state
mark every bundle review_before_sharing and require a human review before public attachment
project a reported visual symptom only as one fixed code plus USER_REPORTED_NOT_AUTOMATICALLY_DIAGNOSED; exclude its title, checks, commands, and free text
evidence_rules: require a bounded schema-valid session.json bound to the selected non-symlink bundle
use sensor_setup.json only while its session, bag, output, profile, and parameter snapshot identities still match
never follow artifact or setup symlinks and never read recorded artifacts outside the session evidence roots
reject a malformed, unknown, mismatched, or automatically attributed reported-symptom claim as invalid diagnosis evidence
report missing, malformed, stale, oversized, or unavailable evidence without inference
support_bundle_contract.json_rule: --json is read-only and writes no ZIP
first_map_handoff_rules: report is the read-only first-map command; support --first-map remains a compatible spelling, --output remains forbidden, and --json selects the schema-valid local-only structured handoff
require a verified session, runner exit zero, required verification PASS, and receipt-bound quality PASS
revalidate the regular in-session receipt and its manifest, diagnosis, and verification-log hashes before showing a handoff

print the copy-ready PASS result, exact source commit or product-version fallback, safe environment hints, verification summary, reviewed JSON receipt path, canonical issue-form URL, and the remaining operator-supplied fields; retain the readable receipt path in structured output when available; the handoff itself is never the public attachment
never upload, open the issue form, or claim an accepted independent validation
write_rules: refuse symlink, non-ZIP, missing-parent, or existing output targets
never upload, open an issue, or mutate remote state
